- Resume & Personal Statement
- Academic transcript(s)
- Degree certificate(s)
- GMAT or GRE score report (if applicable)
- TOEFL or IELTS score report (if applicable)

Interview Requirements.content: Applicant profiles are reviewed upon full completion of online applications and full payment of the application fee. Shortlisted applicants will be invited for admission interview. Interviewees are requested to thoroughly familiarize themselves with the program design and vision as outlined on the website to enhance the interview process and allow for more meaningful discussions. Candidates who do not respond to the invitation of admission interview will **NOT be further considered** for the application.

Academic Requirements.content:
Applicants to the HKUST MSBA are expected to have the following credentials:
- **A Relevant First Degree:** Applicants seeking admission to MSBA program should have obtained a **bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution, or an approved equivalent qualification**.
- **Work Experience:** For the full-time program, relevant work or business experience will add weight to the application under consideration. For the part-time program, **two years of full-time relevant post-qualification work experience is preferred**.
- **Programming Proficiency:** Students are expected to have a **basic proficiency in SQL and Python programming prior to entering the program**. The courses primarily build upon these foundational programming skills, and students should have a solid understanding of SQL and Python to actively engage in coursework and successfully complete assignments.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content: Applicants are highly recommended to take the GMAT/GRE test, but it's **NOT** a compulsory requirement.

Program Overview.content:
The HKUST MSBA program places a primary focus on delivering business value while also fostering the development of advanced data analysis skills and continuous learning and adaptation. Moreover, the program emphasizes the development of skills required to effectively interface with stakeholders from both the business side and technical teams. This inclusive approach, utilizing the strengths of our world-class business school, ensures that students from diverse backgrounds, including those with extensive technical skills such as engineering backgrounds, as well as those with more traditional business backgrounds, can benefit from the program. Our aim is to bridge the gap between academic education and the professional world while producing exceptionally employable graduates.
The program's distinctive curriculum is designed to be intensive, optimizing outcomes for one year of full-time study for recent graduates and two years of part-time study for upskilling and enhanced competitiveness. The program accomplishes this through a blended curriculum that combines an innovative academic program taught by our world-class faculty with mandatory professional workshops in design thinking for business analytics, data management, and the latest data analytics tools, including Auto ML platforms taught from a business perspective. Importantly, there are opportunities for extensive practical experience working with major companies in our elective corporate consulting track sequence. The program experience for students is further enhanced by our active Corporate Advisory Board.
The HKUST MSBA program is offered in both in one-year full-time and two-year part-time study modes. Students are required to attend all classes in HKUST campus. Distance learning or online learning mode is NOT offered.
To support deeper career exploration, MSc full-time students may choose to remain at HKUST for an additional half year during their second year. This option allows students to balance academic learning with practical and international experiences, while maintaining full student status.
How it works
- Students complete up to 28 credits in Year 1
- A minimum of 2 credits must be reserved for the Fall term of Year 2
- These credits can be fulfilled through approved experiential learning activities such as practicum, study tours, or other designated coursework
Why it matters
- Provides greater flexibility for career planning
- Enables participation in internships, industry exposure, and global learning opportunities
- Supports a smoother transition from study to employment

Curriculum.content:
The HKUST MScBA program offers a **one-year full-time or two-year part-time** option. It offers a consultancy and project management track collaborating with global industry leaders. Students have mandatory corporate style workshops in design thinking for business analytics, data base management in business and exposure to the latest data analytics tools to be generally completed in the Fall semester.
To graduate, complete **30 credits**, including **16 credits of Required Courses** and **14 credits of Elective Courses** (which may include the Corporate Consulting Track electives), along with other mandatory requirements. Students can also take up to **34 credits** at no extra cost, subject to approval. The list of Elective Course options is different for each intake and will be announced to students prior to the start of the course registration period.

AI Strategy Track (Elective Course):

MGMT 6051F/H are a university-based consultancy “lab” running data-related business projects for corporate clients; all enrolled students are divided into teams, with each team responsible for completing one project by the end of the semester.
- [Strategic Analytics Implementation](https://msba.hkust.edu.hk/program/program-curriculum#accordion-content-400): continues the real-world projects initiated in Strategy Consulting Analytics and Operations Consulting Analytics, focusing on implementing the solution to the business case recommended during those courses.

Financial Aid.content:
- Admissions Scholarship: To honor exceptional candidates with remarkable potential, this merit-based scholarship is determined after an admission interview. A one-off award covering up to half of MSc Program tuition fees supports academic achievement and future success.
- Academic Achievement Scholarship: Awarded to exceptional students who consistently excel in academics and professional growth, this scholarship highlights their dedication and accomplishments. A one-off grant covering up to half of MSc Program tuition fees supports their continued success.
- Dean’s MSc Admissions Scholarship: To honor exceptional HKUST undergraduates and final-year students with outstanding academic performance, a one-off **HK$100,000** scholarship will be awarded to eligible MSc candidates.
- EmpowerHK Talent Admission Scholarship: Supporting local talents with exceptional academic performance, this scholarship awards a one-off grant covering up to half of the tuition fees for MSc Programs at SBM.
- Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship Scheme for Advanced Studies: The University Grants Committee (UGC) has awarded the HKUST MSBA Program as one of the eligible programs in the Future Talents Scholarship Scheme for the **2026/27 academic year**. All local students pursuing either full-time or part-time study in MSBA may apply for the scheme. Successful candidates will be awarded with a **HK$100,000 tuition waiver**. Click [HERE](https://fytgs.hkust.edu.hk/hong-kong-future-talents-scholarship-scheme-advanced-studies) for more information.
- MSc Alliance Achievement Admission Scholarship: Designed for outstanding candidates from Partner Schools in full-time study mode, this scholarship recognizes academic excellence and diverse experiences with a one-off award covering up to half of MSc Program tuition fees.
- MSc Diversity Excellence Scholarship: To recognize outstanding international applicants, this scholarship fosters cultural exchange and diversity within MSc Programs. A one-off award covering up to half of tuition fees supports global perspectives and inclusion.
- The Belt and Road Admission Scholarship: Recognizing exceptional applicants from the Belt and Road countries, this scholarship celebrates talent and achievement with a one-off award covering up to half of MSc Program tuition fees.
- Eligible applicants admitted to the MSBA Program will be further evaluated for the scholarships based on a rigorous and holistic approach. Successful applicants will be notified by the MSBA Program Office of the scholarship award. **No separate application is required.**

Multiple Applications.content:
- Yes. Applicants may submit more than one application. However, we see the advantage of staying focused and getting prepared accordingly.
- You need to submit an application, pay application fee, upload supporting documents and invite referees for each program you apply.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: Talk with your supervisor/Department/Program Office and seek the approval from them if you wish to apply for the deferral of admission. Usually the deferred admission are valid for **not more than two consecutive regular terms or one year**.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
- Programs may extend conditional offers to selected applicants before the required qualifications are obtained. If you receive a conditional offer, you are required to submit the official final transcripts and degree certificates for verification when available.
- To notify the University that you have met the offer conditions, submit relevant documents as proof as early as possible and **no later than mid-July for Fall admission, or end December for Spring admission**.
- The deposit may, in general, be refunded upon provision of official documents showing that there is a shortfall in meeting the admission condition, subject to the University's discretion and on a case-by-case basis. If you did not attempt to take the test specified in the admission condition, the deposit will not be refunded.
